Run a command in the VM and return its output (non-interactive)

The command and its arguments must follow `--` to avoid conflicting with the optional instance name positional, e.g. `coop exec my-vm -- ls -la` or `coop exec -- ls -la`.

Usage: coop exec [NAME] -- <COMMAND>...

Arguments:
  [NAME]
          Instance name (required if multiple instances exist)

  <COMMAND>...
          Command and arguments to run (after `--`)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
